title: Why you forget English words and how to fix it – level 1
paragraphs: Many students try to learn English words by memory. They feel bad when they forget them. Maybe this is you. You learn the same words again and again, but the words don’t stay in your head. The problem is not your memory. The problem is how you learn.
Words without a story are hard to remember. Your brain needs simple connections. Stories help you make these connections.
LangoPlay is a simple game. The game gives you short stories. You listen, think, and choose the right answer. Each step helps you understand more and remember better.
After some time, you will see a change. You remember words for a longer time. You can use them more easily.
If you want to stop forgetting words, learn with stories. Build a strong memory. Start to play LangoPlay today. Start for free at www.langoplay.com.
